follow_ups.title: GetItemById and UpdateItemV1 return application/json for 400s documented as application/problem+json
follow_ups.reason: BadRequest<ProblemDetails> is sent as application/json while their ProducesResponseType annotations declare application/problem+json, so clients and the OpenAPI document disagree.

follow_ups.title: Leftover whitespace and encoding problems in CatalogApi.cs
follow_ups.reason: dotnet format still reports whitespace at lines 91 and 98 and the file encoding; these were there before this change and a CI format check could flag them.

follow_ups.title: Catalog CreateItem: map a unique key violation to 409 for concurrent creates with the same id
follow_ups.reason: The existence check runs before SaveChanges, so two simultaneous creates with the same new id can still produce a 500 from a Postgres primary key violation.
